summary: Something you learned the hard way may give you a useful advantage in a situation you are only beginning to enter.
body: Something you learned the hard way may give you a useful advantage in a situation you are only beginning to enter. When Chiron sextiles the North Node, an old mistake, rejection, health issue, difficult conversation, or period of feeling unprepared can help you notice the part of a new situation that deserves attention sooner this time. Use the knowledge where it changes the outcome: ask the better question, set the boundary earlier, prepare differently, or help someone avoid the part you had to learn alone.
